label: Immunodeficiency-Associated Childhood Interstitial Lung Diseases: Data from the Türkiye chILD Registry.
summary: Childhood interstitial lung diseases (chILD) and immunodeficiencies are rare, heterogeneous, and clinically challenging disorders. To evaluate the clinical and radiological characteristics of immunodeficiency-related chILD using data from the Türkiye chILD Registry (chILD-TR). Retrospective cohort study.
